d: What happens when a Formula 1 powerhouse suddenly loses its way? Mercedes know the answer. After years of getting the car wrong, questioning their direction and watching their biggest star Lewis Hamilton go to rivals Ferrari, the team have fought their way back to the summit as they won the 2026 Formula 1 World Constructors' Championship. With Toto Wolff leading the rebuild, Kimi Antonelli making history and George Russell delivering, Rupha Ramani looks at the story behind Mercedes' remarkable F1 resurgence.
